name: Necromancer: a Raised Gargoyle closes to melee and fights with its 3 Life Force weight
contract: Raise: Gargoyle 500329 summons creature 50067 and occupies 3 Life Force; Necromancy scales a minion's Attack Power and Spell Power by its Life Force. Its tooltip names no ranged basic attack, and no live record names one. Kept at range (#6737), its only damage was Putrid Claw 805976 (Plague, no spell power coefficient): about 250 damage in 30 s against a golem, while a 1 Life Force Ghoul dealt about 3,000 and a 3 Life Force Abomination about 10,000. Owner ruling (2026-11-15): the Gargoyle fights in melee like the Abomination. It now walks to a golem 15 yards away and its swings carry its weight, while Command: Gargoyle stays an order.
